_dev_notes: DEV NOTE: Freeze-sensitive surfaces manifest. This file lists the path patterns that require extra care during freeze and release work.
DEV NOTE: schema_version identifies the freeze-sensitive-surface schema contract. Changing it is a contract change and must be reviewed deliberately.

DEV NOTE: docs/releases/** protects release documentation because those files describe release state and historical decisions.
DEV NOTE: ci/evidence/** and ci/freeze/** protect evidence, seal, and freeze records because those files support reproducibility and release confidence.

DEV NOTE: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/promotion.md protects the promotion checklist because it controls human review expectations during release promotion.
DEV NOTE: This file defines review sensitivity only. It must not define engine behaviour, registry law, product scope, or release authority by itself.
DEV NOTE: Keep this file strict JSON. Do not add comments, trailing commas, JSONC syntax, or parser-specific extensions.
